Description: Susceptible humans become exposed due to bites from infectious mosquitoes.
Exposed humans progress to the infectious stage.
Infectious humans recover from the infection.
Susceptible mosquitoes become exposed after biting infectious humans.
Exposed mosquitoes progress to the infectious stage.

Name: α_H
Description: Inverse incubation time of ZIKV for human

Name: γ
Description: Recovery rate of an infectious individual

Name: τ_i
Description: Reciprocal of the development time of vectors in stage i

Name: μ_i
Description: Mortality rate of vectors in stage i

Name: κ
Description: Mortality rate of larvae caused by limited carrying capacity

Name: e_V
Description: Number of eggs laid per female mosquito per unit time
